newsitem.title: USA: Staples, Office Depot to extend waiting period.
newsitem.headline: Staples, Office Depot to extend waiting period.

text.p: Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc said Monday they agreed with the Federal Trade Commission to extend the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period to March 5 from February 25.
Staples said the extension is intended to the allow the companies time to provide additional information requested by the FTC with respect to their merger.

Both companies will be holding their special shareholder meetings on February 27. Staples and Office Depot stated that if the FTC clearance has not been received by Febraury 27 they plan to adjourn the meetings for about one week.
Staples and Office Depot signed a definitive agreement last September to merge pending regulatory and shareholder approval.
Staples currently operates 553 office products superstores in over 100 markets across the United States and Canada, while Office Depot operates 571 stores in North America.
